trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Unlock all other 54 trophies in Grand Theft Auto VI to earn the prestigious Platinum trophy. This requires completing the story, mastering all stranger strands, finding all collectibles, and winning all challenges. Not missable as trophies can be cleaned up post-game.
steps: Complete the main campaign and story missions.
Finish all Stranger and Freak strands.
Collect all collectibles, stunt jumps, and meditation spots.
Win all activities, races, and challenges.
Clean up remaining miscellaneous trophies.
sources: PowerPyx GTA VI Trophy Guide: https://www.powerpyx.com

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish the opening story mission Gone Fishing to unlock this narrative trophy. This mission introduces the protagonists and the gorgeous setting of Vice City. It is a mandatory story progression milestone and cannot be missed.
steps: Launch a new game and watch the opening cinematic.
Follow the on-screen objectives during Gone Fishing.
Escape the initial encounter and secure the safehouse.
sources: PowerPyx GTA VI Trophy Guide: https://www.powerpyx.com

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish all core narrative missions comprising Chapter 1 of the campaign. This trophy unlocks automatically as you progress through the main storyline. Ensure you complete all required operations before moving forward.
steps: Progress through the introductory missions of Chapter 1.
Complete the chapter-culminating heist setup.
Watch the cutscene transitioning to Chapter 2.
sources: PowerPyx GTA VI Trophy Guide: https://www.powerpyx.com

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Complete all main story missions in Chapter 2 of the campaign. This chapter expands the criminal network across Vice City and Leonida. It is a story-tied milestone that unlocks upon completion.
steps: Perform the drug trafficking operations in Chapter 2.
Evade local law enforcement during the supply runs.
Finish the final mission of Chapter 2.
sources: PowerPyx GTA VI Trophy Guide: https://www.powerpyx.com

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Conclude all story missions in Chapter 3. This chapter features high-stakes operations and cartel tensions in Vice City. It is required for story progression and unlocks automatically.
steps: Execute the chapter's major syndicate operations.
Survive the ambush at the marina.
Complete the final sequence of Chapter 3.
sources: PowerPyx GTA VI Trophy Guide: https://www.powerpyx.com

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish all missions in Chapter 4 of the main campaign. This penultimate chapter sets the stage for the grand finale. Unlocks automatically upon successful completion of the chapter's climax.
steps: Coordinate the crew for the Chapter 4 operations.
Execute the high-altitude infiltration mission.
Complete the chapter outro cutscene.
sources: PowerPyx GTA VI Trophy Guide: https://www.powerpyx.com

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the epic final mission of the campaign. This golden milestone wraps up the narrative arc of the protagonists in Leonida. Ensure you are prepared with optimal gear and full health before starting.
steps: Initiate the final mission marker on the map.
Navigate through the multi-stage combat encounters.
Make the critical narrative choice in the finale.
sources: PowerPyx GTA VI Trophy Guide: https://www.powerpyx.com

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Successfully complete the mission Breakfast Run early in the game. This mission tests your driving and getaway skills under pressure. Pay attention to dialogue cues so you do not fail optional parameters.
steps: Accept the Breakfast Run task from your contact.
Secure the package from the diner without alerting authorities.
Return to the safehouse within the time limit.
sources: PowerPyx GTA VI Trophy Guide: https://www.powerpyx.com

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Execute and complete The Cartel Heist mission. This is a high-risk robbery requiring precise coordination and crowd control. Missable if ignored during story progression arcs.
steps: Select your crew and approach the cartel facility.
Bypass the security grid and breach the vault.
Escape the pursuing cartel enforcers with the loot.
sources: PowerPyx GTA VI Trophy Guide: https://www.powerpyx.com

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. This mission explores familial ties and underground debts in Vice City. Make sure to complete it when prompted in your mission log.
steps: Meet the contact at the designated warehouse.
Track down the target vehicle across the highway.
Recover the asset and return safely.
sources: PowerPyx GTA VI Trophy Guide: https://www.powerpyx.com

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Finish the mission Headliners in the campaign. Involves infiltrating a high-profile media event to disrupt a rival operation. Missable if you skip optional side branching before moving acts.
steps: Obtain disguise credentials for the venue.
Infiltrate the auditorium during the concert event.
Extract the target without triggering total lockdown.
sources: PowerPyx GTA VI Trophy Guide: https://www.powerpyx.com

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Successfully complete the VCIA Takedown mission. This aerial and ground assault requires precision shooting and vehicle interception. Follow all stage checkpoints to succeed.
steps: Pursue the target transport vehicle along the causeway.
Board the moving vehicle using the grapple rig.
Take control and navigate to the drop zone.
sources: PowerPyx GTA VI Trophy Guide: https://www.powerpyx.com

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the major campaign mission Operation Savage Glory. This large-scale military-grade operation requires heavy weaponry and tactical defense. Ensure your inventory is stocked with armor and ammo.
steps: Deploy to the compound with your strike team.
Eliminate opposing patrols and secure the perimeter.
Defend the objective from counter-attacks until extraction.
sources: PowerPyx GTA VI Trophy Guide: https://www.powerpyx.com

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Achieve 100% overall game completion across story missions, stranger strands, side activities, collectibles, and random events. Check your progress in the pause menu progress tracker. Requires dedication across all gameplay pillars.
steps: Complete all main and stranger missions.
Collect all hidden packages, stunt jumps, and cards.
Win all races, shooting ranges, and activities.
Purchase all properties and complete random events.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Successfully execute and land 250 unique stunt jumps scattered throughout Leonida and Vice City. Use fast sports cars or motorcycles with good acceleration to clear ramps. Track your remaining jumps on the map.
steps: Acquire a high-performance stunt vehicle.
Locate ramps across highways, rooftops, and beaches.
Land successfully on all four wheels for the jump to count.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Participate in all 9 distinct leisure and competitive activity types available in Leonida. Activities include street racing, drone racing, shooting range, fishing, bowling, arcade games, meditation, hunting, and gambling.
steps: Visit a street race and a drone race location.
Try the shooting range and fishing spot.
Play bowling, arcade games, and meditation.
Participate in hunting and gambling.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Achieve a gold medal score in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across Ammu-Nation and club ranges. Focus on rapid target acquisition, accuracy multipliers, and headshots. Memorize target spawn patterns.
steps: Visit shooting ranges across the map.
Practice target switching and reload timing.
Exceed the score threshold for gold on all 42 challenges.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Place first in a Top Fun drone race at all 14 designated locations throughout Leonida. Master agile drone maneuvering through tight alleyways and checkpoint rings. Practice throttle control.
steps: Locate the 14 drone race start points on the map.
Navigate through checkpoint rings without crashing.
Finish with the fastest time to secure victory.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 unique street and off-road races across Leonida. Upgrade your vehicles with engine, transmission, and handling packages to maintain a competitive edge. Avoid collisions in tight corners.
steps: Find race markers on the open world map.
Select a tuned vehicle suited for the terrain.
Finish in first place across 20 different race tracks.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Challenge and defeat Cal at his favorite fishing spot in the Everglades. Use the correct bait, manage line tension carefully, and reel in the heaviest catch to win. Available after meeting Cal.
steps: Locate Cal at the lake dock.
Equip the recommended lure and cast near the weeds.
Reel smoothly while managing line tension to land the fish.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Play and successfully finish any classic arcade cabinet found in bars or safehouses across Vice City. Achieve the target score or beat the game loop to unlock.
steps: Locate an arcade machine in a local bar or safehouse.
Insert virtual tokens to start the cabinet.
Play through and beat the game objective.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission of Andy's stranger strand in Leonida. Follow his narrative arc across multiple encounters and help him resolve his personal struggles. Missable if ignored before the endgame.
steps: Meet Andy at his recurring marker on the map.
Complete his sequential favor tasks.
Finish his final emotional confrontation mission.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the concluding mission for Kenton's stranger questline. Involves tracking marine contraband and dealing with poachers in the bayou. Missable if neglected during free-roam chapters.
steps: Locate Kenton by the docks.
Investigate the suspicious boat wreckage.
Confront the poachers and complete the mission.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish the final chapter of Billy's stranger mission strand. Ride across the Leonida backcountry and help him settle a decades-old score. Missable if you bypass stranger markers.
steps: Find Billy at the desert ranch.
Complete his cross-country escort tasks.
Secure the final rendezvous point.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Successfully complete 8 distinct stranger character mission strands across Leonida. Keep an eye out for question mark (?) icons on your minimap during different times of day.
steps: Explore the map for question mark markers.
Interact with strange characters and accept their tasks.
Complete all multi-part missions for 8 different strangers.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Conclude Randy's smuggling stranger strand. Help him move contraband past rival crews without getting intercepted. Missable if left incomplete before campaign wrap-up.
steps: Meet Randy at his warehouse hideout.
Escort his convoy through hostile territory.
Defend the drop location against attackers.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's street culture stranger questline. Involves high-speed stunt driving and music video coordination across Vice City. Missable if ignored during free-roam.
steps: Connect with Tyrone in downtown Vice City.
Perform precision driving maneuvers for his film crew.
Complete the grand finale showcase.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Visit and complete meditation sessions at all 18 scenic meditation spots across beaches, swamps, and rooftops in Leonida. Look for peaceful retreat circles.
steps: Locate the 18 meditation sanctuary markers.
Interact with the meditation mat to begin.
Maintain steady breathing until the session completes.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Track down and hunt a rare, legendary animal in the Leonida wilderness for Bret. Use bait, cover scent, and scoped rifles to secure a clean harvest. Available via Bret's hunting requests.
steps: Meet Bret at the hunting lodge to get the target dossier.
Inspect tracks and dung in the target hunting zone.
Take down the legendary animal with a precise shot.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Find and collect all cards needed to complete 3 full collectible card sets hidden throughout Leonida. Check convenience stores, beach shacks, and hidden nooks.
steps: Explore shops and residences for trading cards.
Trade duplicates with collectors in Vice City.
Complete 3 full sets to unlock the silver trophy.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the in-game social media app 'WAiNK It' at 100 distinct scenic or notorious landmarks across Leonida. Open your phone camera, frame the landmark, and post.
steps: Open the phone camera app.
Travel to landmarks, statues, and viewpoints.
Snap and upload posts at 100 unique locations.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete any 50 open-world gameplay challenges tracked in your progress log (e.g., headshots, driving distance, weapon kills, robberies). Unlocks naturally during regular gameplay.
steps: Review challenge requirements in the pause menu.
Engage in combat, driving, and criminal activities.
Complete 50 individual challenge tiers.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Trigger a 4-star police wanted level while with your partner, then successfully hide out of sight until the police search meter drains and heat subsides. Use underground tunnels or fast vehicles.
steps: Commit major crimes to reach 4 stars with your partner.
Flee the area using high-speed maneuvers or hideouts.
Remain hidden until the flashing wanted stars disappear.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob three retail stores consecutively with your partner without letting your wanted level drop to zero between robberies. Maintain steady momentum between stores.
steps: Hold up store #1 and grab the cash register drawer.
Flee quickly to store #2 while managing police pursuit.
Rob store #2 and #3 back-to-back without clearing wanted status.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Drive or inspect 100 different vehicle models across Leonida to log them in your vehicle dossier. Look for rare sports cars, classic muscle, trucks, and boats.
steps: Explore city streets and dealership lots.
Enter and drive unfamiliar cars and trucks.
Reach 100 unique discovered vehicles.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Activate the protagonist's Combat Focus ability and successfully eliminate 5 opposing enemies before the focus meter depletes. Best performed during intense firefights.
steps: Build up your Combat Focus meter during combat.
Activate the ability when facing a group of 5+ enemies.
Land quick headshots on 5 targets before time expires.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Execute a daring escape from Vice City International Airport (VCIA) by breaching security gates in a stolen aircraft or vehicle during high alert.
steps: Infiltrate the VCIA tarmac security perimeter.
Seize a parked plane or fast getaway car.
Break through the security checkpoint barriers.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal and pilot a military Rhino tank during a high-level military response, then survive the onslaught. Find them near military checkpoints or secure zones.
steps: Provoke a maximum military response.
Disable and hijack a Rhino tank.
Pilot the tank through the city while under fire.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Plan and execute a stealth jewelry store robbery in Vice City without alerting staff, civilians, or triggering silent alarms. Use silenced weapons or stealth takedowns if necessary.
steps: Disable the store's security box from the alley.
Enter quietly and bag the display cases without making noise.
Slip out the back door before anyone notices.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Successfully plan, breach, and rob 5 different bank vaults across Leonida, then evade the resulting police response. Requires thermal charges or hacking tools.
steps: Locate bank branches in urban and rural districts.
Plant explosives or breach charges on the vault doors.
Grab the cash bags and escape the district alive.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Intercept and rob a moving Group 6 armored security truck on the highway, crack the doors with sticky bombs, and escape the pursuing guards.
steps: Spot an armored security truck on major highways.
Disable the truck and plant a charge on the rear doors.
Collect the money bags and lose the heat.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Uncover and explore all 52 distinct map sectors across the state of Leonida, from Vice City metro to the Keys and Everglades. Travel across every road and region.
steps: Rent a helicopter or fast car for regional exploration.
Drive or fly through all unexplored fog-of-war map areas.
Visit all 52 named districts across Leonida.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Locate and raid underground criminal operations run by each of the 9 rival gangs operating throughout Leonida. Shut down their stash houses and steal their revenue.
steps: Gather intel on gang stash houses from informants.
Infiltrate each gang's stronghold.
Eliminate guards and loot the illegal operation stash.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Visit the famous Ocean Beach promenade in Vice City, sit at a beachside lounge bar, and order a cocktail while watching the sunset over the Atlantic.
steps: Travel to Ocean Beach in Vice City.
Enter the designated beach lounge bar.
Interact with the bar counter to order a drink.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Steal a luxury supercar from a high-end Vice City vehicle showroom and crash straight through the glass front windows in cinematic fashion.
steps: Enter a luxury car showroom in downtown Vice City.
Break into the exhibition vehicle.
Accelerate hard and smash through the glass showroom windows.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Visit the Kolt & Associates bowling alley in Vice City and complete a full game of bowling with a strike on your final frame.
steps: Enter the bowling alley venue in Vice City.
Rent a lane and pick up your bowling ball.
Execute a throw resulting in a strike.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Trigger a special cooperative dual-action moment with your partner during a high-stakes encounter, showcasing synchronized combat prowess.
steps: Engage in combat alongside your partner.
Build the synergy meter to maximum.
Execute the cooperative takedown maneuver.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make 50 consequential narrative and moral choices throughout missions and random encounters across the story arc. Tracked automatically by the game engine.
steps: Play through story missions and encounters.
Make dialogue and action choices when prompted.
Accumulate 50 choice decisions across your playthrough.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Fail a mission or side activity objective once, then successfully complete it on your immediate retry attempt.
steps: Intentionally fail or let a mission objective fail.
Select 'Retry' from the mission failure screen.
Complete the objective successfully on the second try.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Witness one of the bizarre paranormal or UFO easter egg events hidden in the remote swamps of Leonida during late night hours.
steps: Travel to the Everglades swamp region between 1:00 AM and 4:00 AM.
Locate the mysterious glowing anomaly in the marsh.
Observe the supernatural event until it concludes.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock down multiple pedestrians or enemies simultaneously by performing a melee bike or car drive-by maneuver on a crowded sidewalk.
steps: Ride a motorcycle down a crowded Vice City sidewalk.
Equip a melee weapon while driving.
Strike multiple targets in a single pass.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Successfully launder a total of $250,000 in illegal marked cash through front businesses and criminal syndicate contacts across Leonida.
steps: Acquire marked cash from robberies and heists.
Visit laundering contacts and front businesses.
Complete laundering transactions totaling $250,000.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Purchase clothing, vehicle upgrades, weapons, and accessories totaling $100,000 across the various retail outlets in Vice City.
steps: Visit clothing stores, weapon shops, and mod garages.
Buy luxury outfits, gun attachments, and car mods.
Reach $100,000 in cumulative retail spending.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 safehouses and garage properties available for acquisition across Leonida to expand your vehicle storage network.
steps: Locate 'For Sale' property signs on the map.
Earn sufficient cash through missions and heists.
Purchase all 8 garage properties.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Use the in-game Scooter Bros mobile app to register and insure 10 different two-wheeled or compact vehicles found parked around Vice City.
steps: Open the Scooter Bros app on your in-game phone.
Scan 10 different scooters or mopeds on the street.
Complete the registration process for all 10 vehicles.
